equipment_class: # 1) Select the appropriate equipment class from the list (e.g. Servers - Desktop - Laptop - etc.).
# 3) For each piece of equipment provide a unique identifier (e.g. inventory number).
# 4) Enter the equipment name (e.g. 'MacBook Pro' 'Dell Monitor').
# 5) Specify active usage hours per week (hours when the equipment is actively in use: 0-168).
# 6) Specify standby usage hours per week (hours when on standby: 0-168). Note: active + standby must inferior or equal to 168.
# 7) For detailed guidance consult the documentation section: Modules specification - Equipment
# 8) Important: every line starting with # is an instruction. The importer ignores them so you can leave them in the file.
